Definition: Stable record identifier used across repository files
Allowed values or missing rule: Required and unique

Definition: Report title
Allowed values or missing rule: Text; blank only when unavailable in the source record

Definition: Report authors
Allowed values or missing rule: Text; semicolon-separated where normalised

Definition: Publication year
Allowed values or missing rule: Integer year or blank when unavailable

Definition: Journal conference repository or other publication venue
Allowed values or missing rule: Text or blank when unavailable

Definition: Digital object identifier
Allowed values or missing rule: Normalised DOI without URL prefix or blank

Definition: Fire context addressed by the report
Allowed values or missing rule: Controlled descriptive text; not fully coded/not reported when unsupported

Definition: Relationship of the evidence to the fire-plume review scope
Allowed values or missing rule: Direct fire-specific evidence; fire-specific interface/source-state evidence; fire-specific evidence synthesis; or another explicitly bounded category

Definition: One or more observation-to-action tasks addressed by the report
Allowed values or missing rule: Semicolon-separated controlled task labels; missing detail remains explicit

Definition: Physical or computational platform considered
Allowed values or missing rule: Text; not fully coded/not reported when unsupported

Definition: Sensor modality observational source dataset or input data
Allowed values or missing rule: Text; not fully coded/not reported when unsupported

Definition: Primary method model or analytical approach
Allowed values or missing rule: Text; not fully coded/not reported when unsupported

Definition: Normalised setting in which evidence was produced
Allowed values or missing rule: Simulation; retrospective; controlled experiment; field observational; pilot/workflow; operational; review/synthesis; or explicitly reported equivalent

Definition: High-level distinction between field empirical simulation and synthesis evidence
Allowed values or missing rule: Text using the report-supported category

Definition: Design used to evaluate or substantiate the contribution
Allowed values or missing rule: Text; not fully coded/not reported when unsupported

Definition: Reported evaluation outcomes or metrics
Allowed values or missing rule: Text; no metric inferred when absent

Definition: How uncertainty variability or sensitivity was handled
Allowed values or missing rule: Text; not reported when absent

Definition: Descriptive maturity of the reported evidence
Allowed values or missing rule: 0; 1; 2; 3; 4; N/A for evidence syntheses/guidance; or Not fully coded / not reported when a maturity value cannot be supported from the available charting basis

Definition: Maximum inference permitted from the report in this review
Allowed values or missing rule: Required bounded text for substantive use

Definition: Controlled top-level evidence role used for aggregation
Allowed values or missing rule: Direct fire-specific evidence; Fire-specific interface or background evidence; Evidence synthesis or guidance; Transferred adjacent-domain evidence

Definition: Role assigned to the evidence in the synthesis; descriptive subtypes may refine a parent family without creating a new top-level class
Allowed values or missing rule: Parent families: direct fire-specific evidence; conditional interface/source-state evidence; evidence synthesis/guidance; transferred adjacent-domain evidence. Descriptive subtypes are allowed when their parent family remains clear.

Definition: Basis on which the minimum coding was prepared
Allowed values or missing rule: Report text or documented record-level basis

Definition: Status of author verification for eligibility
Allowed values or missing rule: Author-approved eligibility statement or explicit pending status

Definition: Minimum confidence assigned to AI-assisted coding
Allowed values or missing rule: High; Medium; Low; or explicit not assessed

Definition: Completeness and verification status of fine-grained coding
Allowed values or missing rule: Explicit text; missing detail is never silently inferred

Definition: Resolvable DOI link derived from DOI when present
Allowed values or missing rule: https://doi.org/ DOI URL or blank
